summary: The packet's code landed at 81fad5e (the sanctioned subject): the profile-v domain refusal at ALL THREE sites (ProfileLaw::evaluate profile.rs, profile_derivative_v spine_frame.rs:159, profile_derivative_s spine_frame.rs:181) now uses ONE named H-3 constant PROFILE_V_DOMAIN_PAD (1.75e-6 = 1.75x DirectTolerance::parameter, defined on its H-3 line with the justification doc), re-exported pub(crate) via constructive/mod.rs, typed InvalidInput beyond it; the constructor's validate_surface_window, the frozen seam, recipe.rs, truck-shapeops and truck-geotrait are untouched. truck-geometry --lib is green (81/81, incl. the 3 new decorator regression tests) and no landed kernel test flipped red. HOWEVER the packet's done-when is NOT met: the committed pad does NOT turn the 10 recorded showcase tests green, and STOP CONDITION 1 has fired. Full single-job runs of battery_waterslide + pb_contract (the 10 recorded deaths) still die at the spine_frame.rs:448 match-unwrap at iterates DEEPER than the pad. Diagnosis: the funnel's boundary-extent Newton searches are not bounded 'window-grazing' iterates as the packet's model assumed - they leave the recipe domain on BOTH axes by amounts far beyond any tolerance-scale pad (v to -3.021e-6 = 3.02x parameter and continuing past the packet's own 2x refusal probe; s to -2.305e-3 = 2305x parameter). The bounded-pad remedy is necessary but not sufficient, and the packet's test requirement (v = -2*parameter must refuse InvalidInput) caps the v-pad below 2x parameter, so NO in-constraint pad can green the suites. Making the suites green requires an orchestrator amendment beyond this packet's scope/write_allow (recommendation recorded below).

deviation_notes: STOP CONDITION 1 (verbatim from the packet): 'The pad rescues the witness but any showcase test STILL dies at 443 -> a second site exists: diagnose, extend the packet via orchestrator amendment (record in RESULT, do not widen silently).' At the committed pad 1.75e-6 the 10 recorded tests still die at the (relocated) unwrap spine_frame.rs:448. Diagnosis: it is NOT a second v-refusal site. The culprit is assemble.rs:534 boundary_parameter_extent (boolean -> sweep_contact_events -> lift_faces -> face_enclosure -> boundary_enclosure_accumulate -> face_uv_box -> boundary_parameter_extent), which recovers the (u,v) of each sweep-face boundary sample by Surface::search_parameter -> SpineFrameSweep::search_parameter (presearch seed over the window) -> truck-base newton::solve (EXTENT_SEARCH_TRIALS=100). Those Newton walks leave the recipe's global (s,v) domain: measured v-witnesses at s>=0 march -1.2138e-6 (1.21x), -1.5301e-6 (1.53x), -1.8139705e-6 (1.81x), -1.9047643e-6 (1.90x), -2.0063955e-6 (2.01x, PAST the packet's 2x refusal probe), -3.0211255e-6 (3.02x) as the pad is widened, and - once the v-pad is large - a walk that leaves s by -2.305e-3 (v=0.50029; the s-axis refusal fires at the canonical-Curve SpineCurve::position_at/derivative_at checks spine_frame.rs:53/64, whose 1x parameter pad the packet froze). The pad march proves the walks are not bounded grazes. DECISIVE VERIFICATION: with the refusals temporarily neutralized (large v-pad + canonical-Curve s-checks bypassed, both in write_allow, since the failing sweep's recipe spine is S = Box<Curve> per the panic backtrace) battery_waterslide runs 9/9 recorded tests GREEN with correct signed-volume / report / determinism assertions, and only the concave_u_chute expectation (owned by the sibling packet, below) fails. So the funnel HANDLES these walks gracefully (search returns None -> boundary_parameter_extent returns None -> face_uv_box falls back to the window-box certified enclosure); the typed refusals only PANIC the infallible ParametricSurface facade (evaluate_position match-unwrap) before that graceful path can run. Any finite tolerance-scale pad is therefore insufficient by construction, and the packet's own probe requirement makes the v-pad cap un-raisable within the packet. The amendment the orchestrator must make (do not widen silently here): either (a) allow PROFILE_V_DOMAIN_PAD above 2x parameter and move the required refusal probe outward, AND pad/relax the canonical-Curve s-axis refusal band (spine_frame.rs:53/64) to cover the s-walks; or (b) - architecturally cleanest and consistent with the packet's own 'search values are never certificate-quoted' doctrine that sanctions the search-only central_difference_* helpers - let the parametric-surface evaluation path accept finite out-of-window (s,v) by linear extrapolation (ring_point is linear in v; the canonical Curve subs is already total) so the search's own residual gate and trials budget decide acceptance, keeping typed refusals for genuinely invalid construction inputs (non-finite, collapse, correspondence, and far-out-of-domain probes such as the constructive_recipe.rs v = -0.5 assertions). Candidate (b) is entirely within the current write_allow set but relaxes the landed refusal discipline, so it must not be applied without the orchestrator's sign-off.
